Definition

The process of reducing operational overload and alert fatigue for IT and SRE teams by optimizing on-call scheduling, alert thresholds, and workload distribution.

Operational example

Fatigue management strategies include rotating on-call shifts and reducing non-actionable alerts to protect team well-being and incident response quality.
